changes: Recover only short unmoved single touches captured during programmatic iOS page animation; deduplicate each touch.
Displayed page and reading offset follow actual programmatic scroll position, independently of accumulated target.
Body and chapter heading measurements apply only on the relevant settled page; calibration does not remount FlatList.
Keep the same 1pt native rounding tolerance in height correction, so a 0.x pt error does not discard another complete line.
Keep prefetched measurements across unrelated corrections only when layout and body text match; reject old measurements for changed text.
Prefer actual native line bottoms and character boundaries, including when unchanged container size does not emit onLayout; keep a height fallback for unavailable text measurements.
Split an estimated line at the exact native page boundary without dropping or duplicating characters.
Avoid charging an entire estimated row for one or two trailing Chinese closing punctuation marks; native measurements still handle fonts that cannot fit them.
